title: THE LOSSY EXCHANGE
briefing: Deeper in the grid sits an old barter exchange, still counting in brass chits. You start with 12 chits. An A-crate costs 2 chits and sells back for 2. A B-crate costs 3, but the broker skims its resale: it sells back for only 2. The vault floor holds at most 4 B-crates; a fifth one collapses it.

intro: A MARKET WITH NO COMPUTERS. EVERY TRADE ON PAPER.
BUY LOW, SELL LOWER. THE BROKER ALWAYS WINS.
SO DO I. FIVE CRATES, LAWSMITH. THAT IS ALL I NEED.
